title: Imdol VR AI Glasses & VR Headsets
summary: Imdol VR introduces their AI glasses featuring Qualcomm chipset, camera, LED light, 5 mics, 2 speakers for photos, videos, translation, and AI communication.

title: M-Dong Slim 14mm Laptop
summary: M-Dong presents their 14mm slim laptop weighing 990g, featuring an OLED panel, 70W battery, and processor options including Intel Atrox, AMD 6-point, Qualcomm PURE.

title: Levoco's Innovative Power Banks
summary: Levoco highlights their Series 8, an ultra-thin power bank using stainless steel, ATO battery, and integrated chipset. Also a power bank with micro pump cooling technology.

title: Engine AI Robotics: Open-Source Humanoid Robots
summary: Engine AI Robotics presents their PM01 humanoid robot (1.38m, 40kg), full-stack open-source development, 24 degrees of freedom, pricing from $25,000 to $39,000.

title: DE Massage Robot for Business and Personal Use
summary: The DE massage robot features a bed, robot arm with interchangeable heads, and a control panel. Uses camera for body part confirmation with various massage modes.

title: GAOK AI Sleeping Pad & Pillow for Health Monitoring
summary: GAOK showcases AI Sleeping Pad and Belt using piezoelectronic and pressure sensors to track sleep conditions including heart rate, breathing, and snoring.

title: BYE International: K-Pop Inspired Phone Accessories
summary: BYE International from South Korea presents 'Erp Erp' brand phone accessories with character IP licenses and K-pop collaborations including BTS.

title: Innovative Children's Tech: Watches, AI Gadgets, 3D Printers
summary: New children's products including smartwatches with Apple Find My, AI-powered gadgets with ChatGPT for interactive learning, and user-friendly 3D printers.

title: EU Market Trends: Shift to Outdoor & Emergency Products
summary: Bartos from the EU discusses European market shift towards outdoor and emergency products like power banks, blankets, and manual radios due to geopolitical situations.

title: Findy's Tracking Solutions & Chinese Factory Collaboration
summary: Tomas, CEO of Findy (Czech Republic), introduces tracking solutions ecosystem including GPS kids watches, pet trackers, and discusses Chinese manufacturer collaboration.

title: UK Market: Real Leather Preference & Exhibition Sourcing
summary: Haristo from the UK shares insights on UK market's preference for real leather and advises on Global Sources fair strategies for working with smaller factories.
